name: Pocket fanned phones hero
description: An app's hero: a large headline with one word on a soft gradient pill, one sentence, two store buttons and the rating, beside three phones whose screens are drawn in HTML (a plant page, a Today list whose plants can be ticked as watered, a light meter), fanned out over a soft glow that drifts and leans toward the cursor; the phones rise into their fan as the page opens.
